tools.name: read
tools.description: Lab replacement for the built-in read tool.
guidelines: The lab read tool echoes its arguments.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Lab probe: `state` round-trips branch state, `hang` waits for cancellation.

tools.name: burst
tools.description: Lab burst: sends 300 updates, then returns `burst`.

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Posts its arguments as a lab message.

commands.name: plan-task
commands.description: Enters plan mode with the supplied task.

commands.name: skill-input
commands.description: Submits the rendered review skill as a follow-up.

commands.name: skill-focus
commands.description: Compacts with the rendered review skill as focus.

commands.name: again
commands.description: Posts the error from calling itself.

commands.name: flood
commands.description: Fills the runner's host-call slots and posts the queued call's error code.

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Records new journal entry sequence numbers.

commands.name: compact-light
commands.description: Compacts with a focus, or posts busy during a turn.
